statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. The vCluster syncer (./cmd/vcluster) links exactly one package from the module: github.com/docker/docker/pkg/homedir, a helper that returns the user's home directory, reached through github.com/docker/cli/cli/config/credentials. Checked with `go list -deps ./cmd/vcluster` at v0.37.2 (docker v28.5.2) and v0.35.4 (docker v28.3.3): no daemon, plugin or API server package is in the build. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it. Scoped to these exact versions: a tag that links more of docker/docker must be re-checked.

CVE-2026-85747 is in github.com/docker/distribution registry/client: (*manifests).Get never hashes a fetched manifest against the requested digest, and the bundled registry/proxy pull-through cache consumes it (advisory GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3; the v2 module path has no fix, only distribution/v3 3.1.2). This image links other packages of the module (registry/api/errcode, registry/api/v2, reference) but not registry/client or registry/proxy. Verified on 2026-11-11 against every published version: each flagged binary was extracted from GHCR and searched for Go symbol names under docker/distribution/registry/client. and docker/distribution/registry/proxy. (the function table keeps them in stripped binaries); every one returned 0 matches, while connaisseur and harbor-registry, which do link the client, returned matches. The melange recipe repeats that search on every build output and fails the build if one appears.

CVE-2026-41567 is in the Moby/Docker daemon: a malicious container image making the daemon run its own decompression binary on PUT /containers/{id}/archive. Both affected module paths have no fix (only moby/moby/v2 2.0.0-beta.14). The image links Docker client code only and runs no dockerd. Verified on 2026-11-11 against every published version: each flagged binary was extracted from GHCR and searched for Go symbol names under docker/docker/daemon and moby/moby/daemon (the function table keeps them in stripped binaries); every one returned 0 matches, while client-package symbols were found where the client is linked, so the search sees the module. The melange recipe repeats the daemon search on every build output and fails the build if one appears.

CVE-2026-42306 is in the Moby/Docker daemon: a race in docker cp mount setup that redirects a bind mount to a host path. Both affected module paths have no fix (only moby/moby/v2 2.0.0-beta.14). The image links Docker client code only and runs no dockerd. Verified on 2026-11-11 against every published version: each flagged binary was extracted from GHCR and searched for Go symbol names under docker/docker/daemon and moby/moby/daemon (the function table keeps them in stripped binaries); every one returned 0 matches, while client-package symbols were found where the client is linked, so the search sees the module. The melange recipe repeats the daemon search on every build output and fails the build if one appears.

CVE-2026-41568 is in the Moby/Docker daemon: a race in docker cp mountpoint creation (createIfNotExists) that creates files at host paths. Both affected module paths have no fix (only moby/moby/v2 2.0.0-beta.14). The image links Docker client code only and runs no dockerd. Verified on 2026-11-11 against every published version: each flagged binary was extracted from GHCR and searched for Go symbol names under docker/docker/daemon and moby/moby/daemon (the function table keeps them in stripped binaries); every one returned 0 matches, while client-package symbols were found where the client is linked, so the search sees the module. The melange recipe repeats the daemon search on every build output and fails the build if one appears.

GO-2026-5932 covers golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, deprecated and unmaintained, with no fixed version (it now ships as its own module at v0.1.0-deprecated). In the vcluster syncer the only importer is github.com/google/go-github/v30/github (v30.1.0), used by pkg/upgrade to look up releases. go-github uses openpgp only in createSignature (github/git_commits.go:154-166), which Git.CreateCommit calls when a commit carries a SigningKey. vcluster calls only Repositories.GetReleaseByTag (pkg/upgrade/helpers.go:26) and never CreateCommit, so no openpgp code runs. The recipe fails the build if any other package imports openpgp (go list -deps over ./cmd/vcluster) or if vcluster's source calls CreateCommit. Checked 2026-11-11 against vcluster 0.37.7.
